title: Single-setup levelling, rise-and-fall reduction: CONSISTENCY with the book's height-of-instrument result (NAVEDTRA 14069, p. 14-10; case C9)

source.citation: US Navy, Engineering Aid, NAVEDTRA 14069, chapter 14, single-setup example

verification: D-20 condition 2: NUMERICAL CONSISTENCY only. The source reduces this example by the height-of-instrument method (elevation of B 375.15 ft); the rise-and-fall method must give the same number: rise = 11.56 - 1.42 = 10.14, 365.01 + 10.14 = 375.15 (exact arithmetic). Source erratum as for the height-of-instrument case: the text prints the backsight as 11.65 ft but computes with 11.56, which the request uses. Tolerance 0.005 ft.
